question: What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange County to merged Elementary School District schools?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.DOCType = 'Unified School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1.DOCType = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM SchoolInfo AS T1
WHERE T1.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND T1.County = 'Orange'
